title: Hillsboro, OR — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hillsboro, OR: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hillsboro is a city in OR with a population of 108,000. Silicon Forest with Intel’s largest campus and a growing tech ecosystem. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.8.
